provenance: Canonical in-game standing art mirrored by the fan-maintained MGQ wiki. The mirror is not an official publisher site.
usagePolicy: Use the listed standing art only to verify identity, silhouette, palette, costume, and species anatomy. Do not use gallery fan art, AI derivatives, booru/Pinterest mirrors, or files credited as fan drawings.

references.visualNotes: Chibi dog girl; short violet bob and curled ahoge, violet ears and tail, black top, pink skirt, sandals.
